01

Quality is how much QA ran; Result is what it found. QUICK means converted by a registered converter, without review. SAMPLE and FULL mean executed controls or declared oversight on a sample or on every task. Result is GOOD at 90% or more clean reviewed tasks, BAD at 50% or more with issues, and SOME_ISSUES between. QC never rejects. The default view hides QUICK and BAD sources.

02

Counts and areas are measured. Examples is the converted task count and Top curriculum area the subject most converted tasks match, both from a curriculum release named in the source's evidence. Unknown counts or areas include a reason in source details. Daytona shows N/A when the tasks provision no sandbox.
